name: Naloxonazine
summary: Naloxonazine is a potent, irreversible μ-opioid receptor antagonist. Naloxonazine forms spontaneously in acidic solutions of naloxazone, and may be responsible for much or all of the irreversible μ-opioid receptor binding displayed by the latter.

pharmacology.text: Naloxonazine is a potent, irreversible μ-opioid receptor antagonist. Naloxonazine forms spontaneously in acidic solutions of naloxazone, and may be responsible for much or all of the irreversible μ-opioid receptor binding displayed by the latter.

uses.en: It is used in research to block the μ1 opioid receptor for a long time and study what that receptor does.
uses.zh: 它用於研究，可長時間阻斷 μ1 鴉片受體，以探討這種受體的作用。
uses.zhHans: 它用于研究，可长时间阻断 μ1 鸦片受体，以探讨这种受体的作用。

fact.en: Naloxonazine is made of two naloxone molecules linked through their nitrogen-containing groups, and it forms on its own when naloxazone sits in acid.
fact.zh: Naloxonazine 由兩個納洛酮分子經含氮基團相連而成，當 naloxazone 置於酸中時會自行生成。
fact.zhHans: Naloxonazine 由两个纳洛酮分子经含氮基团相连而成，当 naloxazone 置于酸中时会自行生成。
